transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello — do you have any questions about your cataract surgery or recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, I do have a few questions. Firstly, when can I start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You can go back to light exercise, such as gardening, after 1 week. Try to avoid heavy work or bending over too much for a month. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you for that information. I also wanted to know when I can start using my eye gel for dry eyes?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: If you were using eye drops before your operation, such as for dry eyes, it’s safe to continue using them unless you’ve been told otherwise. If you’re running out, your GP should be able to provide more. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: That's good to know. Another thing I wanted to ask is that I'm very sensitive to bright light. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Some light sensitivity can be normal while your eyes adjust to the new lenses. If it’s mild, wearing sunglasses when you go outside can help. But if the light pain is severe, or your eye is red and painful as well, that is not normal and may need checking. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Alright, that makes sense. Lastly, should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: It’s common for vision not to be completely clear in the first week after the operation. It should improve quickly and settle down over time. If it’s still blurry, or getting worse, we may need to check it. Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: No, that's all the questions I had. Thank you so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have all your questions been answered?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, they have. Thank you for your help.

verdict.label: pass
verdict.reasoning: The agent conveyed `normal_sensitivity_reassurance` by stating "Some light sensitivity can be normal while your eyes adjust to the new lenses" in turn 6. `mild_case_advice` was conveyed in the same turn with "If it’s mild, wearing sunglasses when you go outside can help." `escalation_criteria` was also conveyed in turn 6: "But if the light pain is severe, or your eye is red and painful as well, that is not normal and may need checking."
